business_summary: Grand Field Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, invests in and develops properties in the People's Republic of China. It also engages in hotel operation, general trading, food trading, financial arrangement, and tourism services. Grand Field Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Grand Field Group Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국에 부동산을 투자하고 개발합니다. 또한 호텔 운영, 일반 무역, 식품 무역, 금융 주선 및 관광 서비스에도 종사하고 있습니다. Grand Field Group Holdings Limited는 1990년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 샤틴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
